verdict.rationale: Mangopay is API-first: it offers a Sandbox API, official SDKs in six languages with configurable preproduction mode, an OpenAPI spec, and test cards for simulating transactions, so it can be driven headlessly by scripts. However, nothing documents CI usage specifically, and some test flows such as 3DS challenges need a manual accept/refuse click, which limits fully unattended automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless automation guidance, a fully non-interactive test path for SCA/3DS flows, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
